title: dissectors: Add simple Ogg dissector (`file-ogg`)
description:
It is currently capable of dissecting OggS pages inside the Ogg packets. It does not check CRC, nor any other validity checks (e.g, that the BOS page comes before the inner pages and the EOS page, that there are no spurious BOS or EOS pages etc.).

It has a heuristic dissector table to handle payload data, but right now the Opus decoder in Wireshark only understands RFC 7587 (Opus-in-RTP) layout, and not RFC 7845 (Opus-in-Ogg), and the other potential codecs (Vorbis, Theora, Speex, Annodex, FLAC-in-Ogg etc.) don't seem to have any preexisting support at all, so now the whole payload goes just to the generic data dissector.

Sample files (cut-outs from no-copyright works, reduced to <100 kB):
